decompose_timeseries_additive: decompose a time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components using additive STL decomposition
decompose_timeseries_multiplicative: decompose a time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components using multiplicative seasonal_decompose
remove_seasonality: remove seasonality from a time series using the SeasonalityHandler with a specified seasonal period
simulate_arima_timeseries: simulate synthetic time series data from an ARIMA model with configurable AR and MA parameters
simulate_level_shift_anomalies: simulate time series data with injected level shifts, trend shifts, and spike anomalies using the Simulator
